boundary: customer-observed wall clock from requesting an authenticated opaque port lease through the first response byte from the preview route; sandbox and server startup, full-body validation, and cleanup excluded

metadata.http_connection_reuse_source: default benchmark transport with HTTP keep-alives enabled
metadata.cache_state_source: operator-declared; the harness does not clear or mutate host caches
metadata.percentile_method: nearest-rank; successful and failed observed latencies are summarized separately without trimming
metadata.latency_definition: scheduled arrival through verified result; includes client-side admission delay to avoid coordinated omission
metadata.service_latency_definition: request initiation through verified result; excludes client-side admission delay
metadata.command_success_definition: HTTP 200; preview server launch command returns exact generated nonce with a complete ordered zero-exit stream
metadata.scenario_setup_definition: create one sandbox and start a nonce-serving busybox HTTP server
metadata.verification_definition: latency stops at first byte, but success requires HTTP 200 and the full body to exactly match generated nonce bytes
